current_evidence: The council's 'Planning Validation Checklist' download page (downloads/download/10929) offers only this file (959kB). The document text reads 'Adopted September 2026', which postdates the May 2024 draft consultation.

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none)'. Appendix A is a dedicated Householder Applications Checklist with local requirements: Heritage Statement, Structural Surveys, Flood Risk Assessment, Tree Survey, refuse storage and collection facilities, domestic microgeneration/wind turbine details (manufacturer's specification, site plan 1:100/1:200, elevations and roof plans 1:50/1:100), and additional plans (boundary treatment, landscape, street scene).
issues.evidence: Appendix A: Householder Applications Checklist - Local requirements list; 'All relevant documents on the Local Requirements list will be required to be submitted with each application'.

issues.detail: Lawful Development Certificate requirements are filed under Listed building consent: 'Lawful development evidence (statutory declarations etc.)', 'Floor plans / Elevations' and 'Planning Statement' all quote the LDC section (sworn affidavits, statement of grounds on which the Certificate is sought, floor plans not less than 1:100). Meanwhile the 'Lawful development cert' row says '(none)'.
issues.evidence: Lawful Development Certificate section: 'Sworn affidavit(s) from people with personal knowledge...', 'Supporting Planning Statement (to include statement of grounds on which the Certificate is sought)'.

issues.detail: The actual Listed Building Consent requirements are missing: section plan through the building at 1:1 or 1:2; existing and proposed elevations at 1:100 or 1:200; detailed plans at 1:20 showing all new doors, windows and so on; pre-application details; structural survey where required; photographs; Design and Access Statement.
issues.evidence: 'Listed Building Consent Applications - Applications for listed building consent shall be accompanied by: A section plan through the building at a scale of 1:1 or 1:2...'

issues.detail: Climate Change Statement is not captured. It is required for all minor and major development.
issues.evidence: Local requirement 'Climate Change Statement': all minor and major development.

issues.detail: Coal Mining Risk Assessment trigger is missing. The 'Coal Mining / Land Stability Risk Assessment' row quotes only the Land Stability Report text. The CMRA is required for non-householder applications in the Coal Authority Development High Risk Area, excluding householder, heritage consents, advertisements, LDCs, hazardous substances, tree works and prior notifications.
issues.evidence: Local requirement 'Coal Mining Risk Assessment' (Development High Risk Area; exemptions listed).

issues.detail: Crime Impact Statement is not captured. Triggers: residential of 25+ dwellings, multi-occupancy of 20+ rooms, commercial units over 100 sqm or more than 3 units, hotels, care homes, licensed premises and similar listed uses.
issues.evidence: Local requirement 'Crime Impact Statement' (list of qualifying uses).

issues.detail: Proof of Marketing Statement is not captured. It applies to re-use of employment sites for housing under Local Plan Policy EMP3, normally with 12 months' marketing. The 'Employment / Economic Statement' row holds only the fragment 'with Rossendale's employment land and commercial property market. 29.'
issues.evidence: Local requirement 'Proof of Marketing Statement' (Policy EMP3, normally 12 months).

issues.detail: Several other local items are missing: Access Ramp Details (new external ramp); Adoption Statement (new internal roads or connections to highways/services); Shopfront Details (new shopfronts); M4(2) accessible homes plan for 5+ dwellings; Demolition requirements (prior approval outside a Conservation Area, or full permission inside one with floor plans, structural survey, ecology, tree survey and heritage statement); Planning Statement for all major development (it appears only under LBC, with LDC text); local BNG extras (draft Biodiversity Gain Plan, HMMP, GIS files); surface water drainage strategy for all development (Grokbot records only the major-development SuDS pro-forma).
issues.evidence: Local requirements 1-3, 7, 11, 12, 27, 30 of the September 2026 checklist.

issues.detail: The Wind Energy section is not captured. It applies to all wind energy applications, with pre-application consultation for more than 2 turbines or hub height over 15m. Items: photomontages/wireframes; ZTV maps (unless a single turbine of 25m or less with none within 1km); Public Rights of Way plan within 10x turbine height; noise and shadow flicker (ETSU-R-97); peat and hydrology for multiple turbines or single turbines over 25m; decommissioning bond for multiple turbines or single turbines over 40m; communications/broadcast impacts.

Rows marked '(none)' ignore sections the checklist does have. Works to trees: expert or diagnostic evidence for TPO trees, numbered sketch plan (Appendix C), photographs, evidence of damage or disease. Variation of condition s73 and Non-material amendment: description listing all amendments, supporting statement, original and amended plans with changes identified. Change of use - prior approval: demolition prior approval and agricultural prior notifications (Appendix D pro-forma) are covered. The Dropped kerb section (Certificate B with 21 days' notice to LCC, location plan, site plan at 1:200/1:500) is also not captured.
issues.evidence: Application-type sections: 'Tree Works', 'S.73 and Non-Material Amendments', 'Dropped Kerb', 'Agricultural Development', Local requirement 11 'Demolition'.

issues.detail: About 35 local requirements are tagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', but the checklist applies the Local Requirements list to every relevant application, so FRA, Land Contamination, Ecology, Tree Survey and others apply to outline applications too. Outline gets only Drainage and Fire Statement. The Outline section's own requirements (state the proposed use(s) and amount of development; mark illustrative plans 'Illustrative') are also missing.
issues.evidence: 'All relevant documents on the Local Requirements list will be required to be submitted with each application'; Outline section.

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts come from the wrong text. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' quotes the Mineral Resource Assessment; 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' quotes the table of contents and introduction; 'Roof plan' quotes fee text ('The Application Fee When submitting...'); 'Photographs' quotes bat survey text; 'Environmental Statement' quotes 'the CMRA should be included within the ES'; 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is a method-statement fragment; 'Design and Access Statement' quotes the householder plan list; 'Highways / access details' and 'Existing and proposed site levels' are mid-sentence fragments.
issues.evidence: e.g. Advertisement row: '...Hours of illumination Mineral Resource Assessment Large scale or major development proposals located with a mineral safeguarding area...'

issues.detail: Thresholds are missing or misstated. FRA: the excerpt is a fragment; the source requires it for sites of 1ha+ in Flood Zone 1, all new development in Zones 2 and 3, and more-vulnerable development at risk from any flood source. Transport Assessment: the excerpt is parking-statement text; the source sets thresholds (e.g. dwellings above 50 units for a TS, above 80 for a TA). Fire Statement: the excerpt is a footnote defining major development, not the relevant-building test (2+ dwellings or educational accommodation, and 18m+ or 7+ storeys). Air Quality: omits the 10km designated-site trigger. DAS: omits the major / Conservation Area 1+ dwelling or 100sqm / LBC triggers.
issues.evidence: Local requirements 15 (FRA), 36 (Transport), National requirement 6 (Fire Statement), 5 (DAS), Local requirement 5 (Air Quality).

issues.detail: Several tab_items are process text or fragments, not requirements: 21-day invalid-application notice; 'treated as withdrawn, a refund of any fee paid will be arranged'; 'can also be completed electronically and submitted... by email'; 'Only 1 paper copy of the planning submission is required. 2.'; redaction requests; 'Although not a requirement of legislation, the inclusion of a linear scale bar is also useful' (which says outright it is not a requirement); 'foul drainage assessment (FDA) form - these are available at:' (cut-off fragment); designated sites list truncated at 'Ancient Woodland bu'.
issues.evidence: tab_items under 'Submission rules', 'Drawing / document standards', 'Local forms / checklists', 'Policy-driven requirements'.

issues.detail: The same rules appear more than once in tab_items: drawing register requirement (twice); filename format and filename/drawing match rule (three entries); commercially sensitive / personal information redaction note (twice).
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'All applications must be accompanied by a list of submitted drawings (drawing register sheet)...' and 'All applications must be also accompanied by a list of submitted drawings (drawing register)...'

issues.detail: The List date (2026-09-01) is about right, but the 'Date basis' is PDF metadata CreationDate. The document text itself says 'Adopted September 2026', and that should be cited instead.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Rossendale checklist (text says 'Adopted September 2026'). The extraction is poor: Householder is marked '(none)' despite a dedicated Appendix A checklist, LDC requirements are filed under Listed building consent, many triggers quote the wrong text, and requirements such as the Climate Change Statement, Coal Mining Risk Assessment, Crime Impact Statement and Wind Energy items are missing.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
